svg.title: One Session, four views on the phone
svg.desc: A phone showing one claude Session in ~/zen. New session lists Shell, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Pi, OpenCode and DSH. Chat shows the request, tool rows and the reply. Terminal shows the same Session as the live terminal grid. Git shows three changed files and a diff.
